css: .direct-gl-voucher{font-family:'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif;color:#111;font-size:11pt}.direct-gl-voucher h1{margin:0 0 4px 0;font-size:20pt;color:#0a4185}.direct-gl-voucher .subtitle{color:#666;margin-bottom:14px}.direct-gl-voucher table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-bottom:12px}.direct-gl-voucher th,.direct-gl-voucher td{border:1px solid #ccc;padding:6px 8px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top}.direct-gl-voucher th{background:#eef2f7;font-weight:600}.direct-gl-voucher .table-title{font-weight:600;padding:6px 8px;background:#0a4185;color:#fff;font-size:11pt}.direct-gl-voucher .amount{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.direct-gl-voucher .totals-row td{font-weight:700;background:#f5f7fa}.direct-gl-voucher .balance-check{padding:6px 8px;background:#e7f4ea;border:1px solid #b3d6bb;color:#144d1b;margin:8px 0;font-weight:600}.direct-gl-voucher .balance-check.error{background:#fbecec;border-color:#e5b7b7;color:#7f1f1f}.direct-gl-voucher .footer{margin-top:22px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between}.direct-gl-voucher .sig{width:220px;border-top:1px solid #444;padding-top:4px;text-align:center;color:#555;font-size:9pt}
